43.sql:
WITH c_cols AS (
    SELECT ss.cds, ss.`AvgScrMath`, ss.`AvgScrRead`, ss.`AvgScrWrite`, sc.`County`
    FROM satscores AS ss
    JOIN schools AS sc ON ss.cds = sc.`CDSCode`
),
c_rows AS (
    SELECT cds, `AvgScrMath`, `AvgScrRead`, `AvgScrWrite`, `County`
    FROM c_cols
    WHERE `AvgScrMath` IS NOT NULL AND `AvgScrRead` IS NOT NULL AND `AvgScrWrite` IS NOT NULL
),
c_agg AS (
    SELECT cds, AVG(AvgScrMath + AvgScrRead + AvgScrWrite) AS avg_total_score, County
    FROM c_rows
    GROUP BY cds, County
),
c_min AS (
    SELECT cds, avg_total_score, County
    FROM c_agg
    ORDER BY avg_total_score ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT s.`AvgScrMath`, sc.`County`
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc ON s.cds = sc.`CDSCode`
WHERE s.cds = (SELECT cds FROM c_min);

510.sql:
WITH c_cols AS (
    SELECT `id`, `artist`, `convertedManaCost`, `side`
    FROM cards
),
c_rows AS (
    SELECT `id`, `artist`, `convertedManaCost`
    FROM c_cols
    WHERE `side` IS NULL AND `convertedManaCost` IS NOT NULL
),
t_join AS (
    SELECT `artist`, `convertedManaCost`
    FROM c_rows
),
t_agg AS (
    SELECT `artist`, MAX(`convertedManaCost`) AS max_cost
    FROM t_join
    GROUP BY `artist`
),
t_final AS (
    SELECT `artist`, `max_cost`
    FROM t_agg
    ORDER BY `max_cost` DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT `artist` FROM t_final;

WITH c_fuzzy AS (
    SELECT h.id, h.`superhero_name`, h.`full_name`, ha.`attribute_value`
    FROM superhero h
    JOIN hero_attribute ha ON h.id = ha.hero_id
    JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
    WHERE 
        a.attribute_name LIKE '%strength%' 
        OR a.attribute_name LIKE 'strength%' 
        OR a.attribute_name LIKE '%strength' 
        OR a.attribute_name = 'strength' 
        OR a.attribute_name LIKE '% Strength%' 
        OR a.attribute_name LIKE '% strength'
),
c_max AS (
    SELECT `full_name`, MAX(`attribute_value`) AS max_strength
    FROM c_fuzzy
    GROUP BY `full_name`
),
c_name AS (
    SELECT `full_name`, max_strength
    FROM c_max
    WHERE max_strength = (SELECT MAX(max_strength) FROM c_max)
),
c_final_check AS (
    SELECT `full_name`
    FROM c_name
    WHERE `full_name` != '-'
    ORDER BY `full_name` ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT * FROM c_final_check;

944.sql:
WITH champion AS (
    SELECT r.milliseconds
    FROM results AS r
    INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
    WHERE r.raceId = 125 AND r.position = 1
    LIMIT 1
),
last_driver AS (
    SELECT r.milliseconds
    FROM results AS r
    INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
    WHERE r.raceId = 125
    ORDER BY r.milliseconds DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    (last_driver.milliseconds - champion.milliseconds) / last_driver.milliseconds * 100 AS percentage_faster
FROM champion, last_driver;

stats.gold_sql: WITH time_in_seconds AS ( SELECT T1.positionOrder, CASE WHEN T1.positionOrder = 1 THEN (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.time, 1, 1) AS REAL) * 3600) + (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.time, 3, 2) AS REAL) * 60) + CAST(SUBSTR(T1.time, 6) AS REAL) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(T1.time, 2) AS REAL) END AS time_seconds FROM results AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId WHERE T2.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND T1.time IS NOT NULL AND T2.year = 2008 ), champion_time AS ( SELECT time_seconds FROM time_in_seconds WHERE positionOrder = 1), last_driver_incremental AS ( SELECT time_seconds FROM time_in_seconds WHERE positionOrder = (SELECT MAX(positionOrder) FROM time_in_seconds) ) SELECT (CAST((SELECT time_seconds FROM last_driver_incremental) AS REAL) * 100) / (SELECT time_seconds + (SELECT time_seconds FROM last_driver_incremental) FROM champion_time)

         AND position = '1st') AS champion_time,
        (SELECT milliseconds FROM results

FROM Player
JOIN Player_Attributes ON Player.`player_api_id` = Player_Attributes.`player_api_id`
WHERE `player_name` IN ('Alexis', 'Ariel Borysiuk', 'Arouna Kone')
GROUP BY `player_name`
ORDER BY max_crossing DESC
LIMIT 1;

FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.`player_api_id` = pa.`player_api_id`
WHERE p.`height` > 180
GROUP BY p.`player_api_id`
ORDER BY (SUM(pa.`heading_accuracy`) / COUNT(pa.`player_fifa_api_id`)) DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT p.`player_name`, SUM(pa.`heading_accuracy`) / COUNT(pa.`player_fifa_api_id`) AS average_heading_accuracy
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.`player_api_id` = pa.`player_api_id`
WHERE p.`height` > 180
GROUP BY p.`player_api_id`
ORDER BY average_heading_accuracy DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH t_height AS (
    SELECT p.`player_name`, pa.`heading_accuracy`, pa.`player_fifa_api_id`
    FROM Player p
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.`player_api_id` = pa.`player_api_id`
    WHERE p.`height` > 180
),
t_agg AS (
    SELECT `player_name`, SUM(`heading_accuracy`) AS total_heading_accuracy, COUNT(`player_fifa_api_id`) AS count
    FROM t_height
    GROUP BY `player_name`
)
SELECT `player_name`
FROM t_agg
ORDER BY (total_heading_accuracy / count) DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT player_name
FROM (
    SELECT player_name, SUM(heading_accuracy) / COUNT(player_name) AS average_heading_accuracy
    FROM (
        SELECT p.player_name, pa.heading_accuracy
        FROM Player p
        JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
        WHERE p.height > 180
    ) AS t_height
    GROUP BY player_name
)
ORDER BY average_heading_accuracy DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT p.`player_name`, 
       SUM(pa.`heading_accuracy`) / COUNT(p.`player_fifa_api_id`) AS average_heading_accuracy
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.`player_api_id` = pa.`player_api_id`
WHERE p.`height` > 180
GROUP BY p.`player_api_id`
ORDER BY average_heading_accuracy DESC
LIMIT 10;

    SELECT `player_name`

    SELECT t.`CustomerID`, t.`Date`, t.`Price`, t.`Amount`, p.`ProductID`
    FROM transactions_1k AS t
    JOIN products AS p ON t.`ProductID` = p.`ProductID`
    WHERE p.`ProductID` = 5
),
c_rows AS (
    SELECT t.`CustomerID`
    FROM c_cols t
    WHERE t.`Price` / t.`Amount` > 29.00
),
t_join AS (
    SELECT y.`CustomerID`, y.`Consumption`
    FROM c_rows r
    INNER JOIN yearmonth y ON r.`CustomerID` = y.`CustomerID`
    WHERE y.`Date` = '201208'
),
final_result AS (
    SELECT `CustomerID`, `Consumption`
    FROM t_join
    GROUP BY `CustomerID`
),
t_final AS (
    SELECT `CustomerID`, `Consumption`
    FROM final_result
),
final_answer AS (
    SELECT `CustomerID`, `Consumption`
    FROM t_final
),
final_output AS (
    SELECT `CustomerID`, `Consumption`
    FROM final_answer
)
SELECT `CustomerID`, `Consumption`
FROM final_output;
